| 2026-05-29 | **2 pilot blockers diagnosed + fixed in one session via PR [#614](https://github.com/iscasasola/setnayan-platform/pull/614) (MERGED) — admin console crash + shop console redirect-loop.** Owner-reported 3 days before pilot 2026-06-01: *"Cannot see the vendor dashboard via shop console. Admin console said something went wrong, and it does not load also."* Reproduced both locally via dev-server stub-bypass; net +40/-2 across 2 files. **Bug 1 · /admin throws on every authed render.** `apps/web/app/admin/_components/admin-bottom-nav.tsx` shipped as a Server Component (no `'use client'` directive) that built `ADMIN_BOTTOM_NAV_ITEMS` as a const array of `{key, label, href, icon: LucideIcon, activeMatch}` entries, then passed the array as a prop to `<BottomNav>` — the Client Component primitive from PR #603 nav phase 0. Lucide icons are `forwardRef` objects (`$$typeof` + `render`); Next.js can't serialize them across the Server→Client prop boundary so the admin layout threw into the root error boundary (`apps/web/app/error.tsx` "Something on our end didn't work · We've logged the issue ..."). Dev-server stub-bypass repro confirmed the exact error verbatim: `Error: Functions cannot be passed directly to Client Components unless you explicitly expose it by marking it with "use server"... {$$typeof: ..., render: function House}` (also LayoutList, Users, DollarSign, Menu). Fix: mark `admin-bottom-nav.tsx` as `'use client'` so the icon refs stay on the client side and never traverse the boundary. Symmetric with `admin-sidebar.tsx` which has been `'use client'` since PR #606 for exactly the same reason. Inline WHY block added so future agents extending the admin nav don't drop the directive. Verified: stubbed /admin response flipped 500 → 200 with full chrome rendering ("Setnayan · Admin" / "Switch view" / Queues / Money / Operations all present). Root cause: PR #606 (Phase 3 admin IA · merged 2026-05-29T06:02Z) introduced the new client-primitive `BottomNav` + new wrapper `admin-bottom-nav.tsx` simultaneously; typecheck + lint + build all pass with the wrapper as a Server Component because the type system has no way to detect the RSC serialization constraint statically; the regression only surfaces on actual authed render (none of CI's headless fetches reach the post-auth path). **Bug 2 · /vendor-dashboard redirect-loops §10a Internal Accounts.** `apps/web/app/vendor-dashboard/layout.tsx` line 53-56 gated entry on the rigid `profile?.account_type !== 'vendor'` predicate. But the always-visible role pill (`apps/web/app/_components/role-switch-pill.tsx:82-95`) offers the Shop console target whenever `roles.hasVendorAccess` is TRUE — computed in `apps/web/lib/roles.ts:165-167` as "owns a vendor_profile OR sits on any vendor_team_members row" independent of account_type. Net: §10a Internal Account (`is_internal=TRUE` per CLAUDE.md 2026-05-12 row "Owner / Internal Accounts — permanent unlimited-use grants locked", account_type typically 'admin') who also owns a vendor_profile for pilot dogfooding saw Shop console in the pill, clicked it, got silently bounced back to /dashboard. Same path lit up for any dual-role user (vendor team-member on someone else's profile + customer on their own events). Fix: swap the predicate to `!roles.hasVendorAccess`. The roles summary is already fetched in the same `Promise.all` so this is a zero-cost predicate change. Aligns the layout's gate with the canonical access rule the role pill enforces. Per CLAUDE.md 2026-05-15 dual-role lock ("a single users row may carry account_type='vendor' AND own/host events as a customer · Vendor application is additive") + 2026-05-20 Login-landing rule lock ("admin + vendor consoles reached via role-switch pill only") — the role pill IS the canonical access gate, and any console layout must accept users the pill grants access to. **Engineering process notes.** Both bugs were initially invisible because (a) typecheck + lint + production build all pass clean (no static detection of RSC serialization constraints OR semantic-only access-gate drift); (b) the only CI runtime check (Playwright e2e) doesn't have an authed admin journey wired up; (c) the unauthed fetch path renders 307 redirect via the early `if (!user) redirect(...)` so curl-based smoke tests never reach the crash. Root cause identification took ~25 min of dev-server stub-bypass — patched the admin layout to inject a fake authed profile, then fetched /admin to see the actual runtime error, which immediately surfaced the lucide forwardRef serialization message. Logged as a process improvement for future RSC nav primitive landings: any time a Server Component holds an array literal containing component refs and passes it to a Client Component prop, add the `'use client'` directive to the wrapper file by default (or refactor to pass primitive keys instead of refs). **Scope.** No schema migration · no SKU/pricing change · no V1 scope expansion · pilot 2026-06-01 unblocked. PR #614 auto-merged on green (per `[[feedback_setnayan_pr_auto_merge]]`). Branch + worktree cleaned up post-merge. **Cross-references.** [PR #606](https://github.com/iscasasola/setnayan-platform/pull/606) `feat(nav phase 3): admin console IA` (the regression-introducing PR) · [PR #603](https://github.com/iscasasola/setnayan-platform/pull/603) `feat(nav): Phase 0 shared nav primitives` (defines the BottomNav client primitive) · CLAUDE.md 2026-05-15 dual-role lock + 2026-05-20 Login-landing rule lock (the role-pill access model that the vendor-dashboard guard must align with) · CLAUDE.md 2026-05-12 §10a Internal Accounts lock (the owner-account configuration that triggered Bug 2). Per `[[feedback_setnayan_document_changes_with_why]]` this row carries the canonical WHY for both fixes; per `[[feedback_setnayan_orphan_prevention]]` no new orphans (`/admin` still reachable from role-pill Admin console target · `/vendor-dashboard` still reachable from role-pill Shop console target with broader-access predicate). **`.docx` mirror regenerated alongside this row** via pandoc per established convention (pandoc available at `~/.local/bin/pandoc` v3.9.0.2 per CLAUDE.md 2026-05-20 row 450). **Sequencing note:** Pure pilot-polish row · 1 PR shipped + merged · no schema · no SKU/pricing · no scope expansion · pilot 2026-06-01 unblocked.

(9) Local `pnpm -F web build` passed cleanly (exit 0 · /venue/[slug] compiled to 2.73 kB · 115 kB First Load JS). (10) Parallel agent shipped the SAME fix at the same time via **PR #626** ("fix(build): wrap admin/offline dynamic import in client component") using a slightly different naming (`OfflineDiagnosticLoader` function export vs my `OfflineDiagnostic` const re-export · both equally valid). PR #626 merged first · my branch became identical to main · `gh pr create` failed with "No commits between main and claude/fix-offline-page-ssr-false" which is the correct outcome. (11) Pushed another empty commit `d49a274` to trigger a fresh Vercel build now that both ESLint AND Server Component blockers are resolved. (12) Polling for deploy completion · expecting `venue=3 · vendors=2 · pricing=2` ld+json blocks per page when the build lands. **The real lesson:** when 4+ PRs merge within 10 minutes (08:11 → 08:20Z on 2026-05-29) AND a build-breaking change is in main BEFORE the SEO PRs, **all subsequent PRs deploy "successfully" from a code-on-main perspective but never reach production** because Vercel serves the last successful build for all routes that compiled in it. Vercel's GitHub status check appears under `production build` (GitHub Actions) — when that fails, the matching Vercel deploy also fails, but the deploy failure is silent unless someone checks the Vercel dashboard. **PR #624 fixed ONE of TWO build-blockers · I introduced one of them (Buckets 5+7 ESLint reference) · PR #623 introduced the other (offline page Server Component) · neither author caught the other's issue.** PR #626 fixed the second one ~3hr after the sprint closed · my empty commit re-triggered the build. **Pattern lock for future SEO/JSON-LD work in this repo:** (a) NEVER use `// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` · this project's ESLint config doesn't register the `@typescript-eslint` plugin · use `Record<string, unknown>` typing instead OR no comment at all and let TS infer. (b) NEVER use `dynamic({ ssr: false })` inside a Server Component (anything that exports `metadata` or doesn't have `'use client'`) · always wrap in a Client Component module. (c) After a big merge burst, **always curl the live HTML** to verify the changes are actually rendering before declaring the sprint complete. The owner's GSC inspection caught this · I declared the sprint complete prematurely · production state did not match `origin/main`. (d) **Add a smoke test to CI**: a post-build check that curls each public route and verifies the expected JSON-LD block count. Would have caught this at deploy time. Logged for next Cowork pass as a V1.x follow-up. **Affected files this row** · CLAUDE.md (this row only) · the actual engineering work happened in PR #626 (parallel agent · merged to main as commit `06a42c6` + merge `a3b1928`) · plus my empty trigger commits `29127ce` + `d49a274`. **Sequencing note:** This is the third 2026-05-29 row in the SEO/GEO Sprint arc · (1) partial-progress mid-sprint row · (2) sprint-complete row at 08:20Z · (3) THIS row · post-sprint-close-out hidden-blocker discovery + resolution. **The real production-live status flips from "all 8 buckets live" → "Buckets 1+2+3+4 live · Buckets 5+6+7+8 missing in prod despite being on main" → (after current deploy completes) "all 8 buckets live for real this time".** Pilot 2026-06-01 unaffected · this all resolves pre-pilot · zero behavior change for in-product UX · pure structured-data surface for AI engines + Google. **`.docx` mirror regeneration deferred to next Cowork settling pass** (pandoc available · single-row update would be heavy regen for relatively small content addition).

Owner directives across the conversation: (a) *"officiants should be provided by the church and precana? so can we just remove them?"* → DON'T remove · auto-resolve instead · (b) *"auto resolve. also when vendors provide bundles that include multiple services, they can add them to the short list. so we can also place the total budget. If there is a range. then budget should also show in range based on their chosen shortlist."* · (c) *"yes we do have shortlist as discussed before. also favorites so they will show everytime they create a new event in the future"* · (d) *"yes do them now."* Consolidates 5 locks into one architectural row per the established "Vendor Discovery Architecture" framing. **(1) Card 04 Officiant auto-resolve.** Catholic + parish church match (`event_vendors` religious_venue locked + `venue_directory.compatible_ceremony_types[]` contains `'catholic'`) → "Officiant provided by {Parish Name}, confirmed via Pre-Cana" status surface (no vendor pick required · Mark-Done CTA). Civil + locked venue with `venue_setting='civil_registrar'` → "Provided by {City Hall/Municipal Hall}" status. INC + INC chapel match → "Provided by {INC Chapel}" status. All other combinations (Christian non-bundle / Muslim / Cultural / Mixed / destination / Catholic-at-non-church) → standard vendor picker. "Bring your own officiant" override affordance ALWAYS available for the real PH edge cases (interfaith ceremonies · family priest from a different parish with permission letter · retired pastor · destination celebrant · NCR civil-with-hired-celebrant trend). Reads `events.ceremony_type` + the locked `event_vendors` row for `religious_venue` canonical_service to detect bundle case. Mirrors the religion-adaptive copy pattern from CLAUDE.md 2026-05-22 row 9 PR #314 — different state per event signals, taxonomy stays intact. Card 04 stays as canonical Wizard task in the 48-card sequence; the surface just renders Mark-Done CTA instead of picker when auto-resolve fires. The 192-canonical taxonomy stays locked — auto-resolve is a UX layer that maps event context to "bundled" vs "vendor-pick" states without changing the underlying taxonomy structure. **(2) Bundle expansion to multi-row shortlist** (extends CLAUDE.md 2026-05-24 seventh row package-inclusion from `status='locked'` to also cover `status='considering'`). When a host shortlists a vendor whose `vendor_services.included_services TEXT[]` lists OTHER canonical_services, those services auto-populate as `event_vendors` rows with `inclusion_source='package'` + `parent_vendor_id=<vendor>` + `parent_package_id=<vendor_service>` + `status='considering'`. Plan grid cells render "✓ Considering with {Vendor Name}'s {Package Name}" cream-tinted chip styling (visually distinct from emerald-tinted locked-package chip from 2026-05-24 row). Removing the parent shortlist row auto-removes all bundle-included shortlist rows via cascading delete. Schema: status enum + `event_vendors.inclusion_source` + `parent_vendor_id` + `parent_package_id` columns from 2026-05-24 seventh row already cover this — only the auto-population trigger needs extension to fire on `status='considering'` INSERTs (currently the trigger fires only on `status='locked'`). **(3) Vendor service price ranges.** Schema: `ALTER TABLE vendor_services ADD COLUMN price_max_centavos INT NULL CHECK (price_max_centavos IS NULL OR price_max_centavos >= base_price_centavos)` (existing `base_price_centavos` becomes canonical min · NULL `price_max` = single price · non-NULL = range). Vendor-side UI on `/vendor-dashboard/services/[id]` gains a "Quote a range" toggle that exposes min + max inputs when active (single price the default · range opt-in). Display: `price_max IS NULL` → single "₱X" / `price_max IS NOT NULL` → range "₱X–₱Y". Existing fixed-price services stay valid (no backfill needed). RLS unchanged. **(4) Shortlist budget total + range math (new surface).** New `<ShortlistBudgetCard>` component on event-home + per-cell sub-totals on Plan grid. Math: `min_total = SUM(price_min)` and `max_total = SUM(COALESCE(price_max, price_min))` across `event_vendors` rows where `status IN ('considering','contracted','deposit_paid')` for the active event. Display rules: all rows have NULL `price_max` → single "Shortlist total: ₱X" / any row has `price_max IS NOT NULL` → range "Shortlist total: ₱X–₱Y" / mixed locked vs considering → segment breakdown ("₱180,000 locked + ₱120,000–₱250,000 considering · ₱300,000–₱430,000 total"). Compares against `events.wedding_budget_centavos` if set ("₱350,000–₱500,000 of ₱600,000 budget" + progress bar with min anchor + max range whisker). Stays SEPARATE from iteration [0007 Budget & Expenses](0007_budget_expenses/0007_budget_expenses.md) canonical ledger which tracks locked + paid line items only — no conflation between the locked-budget ledger (0007) and the running-shortlist-estimate surface (this row). New helper `lib/shortlist-budget.ts` computes min/max totals + delta against budget cap. **(5) Favorites — persistent per-user across events (new feature surface).** New table `user_favorite_vendors` (user_id UUID FK · vendor_profile_id UUID FK · canonical_service TEXT snapshot for filter · favorited_from_event_id UUID FK NULL for audit trail · notes TEXT NULL for host's personal note · favorited_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()) with composite PK `(user_id, vendor_profile_id)`. Indexes: `(user_id, favorited_at DESC)` for chronological listing + `(vendor_profile_id)` for vendor-side "Favorited by N couples" stat. RLS: user reads/writes own rows only. **Multi-host events (iteration 0048) keep each host's favorites private — favorites are personal taste, not event-shared** (different from shortlist which IS event-shared across multi-host per existing 0048 visibility tags). New surfaces: (a) Heart/Save button (Lucide Heart icon) on marketplace vendor cards + `/v/[slug]` profile + shortlist rows in Plan grid · (b) New `/dashboard/favorites` listing grouped by canonical_service with quick "Add to current event" action per row (when host is inside an event context) · (c) **NEW Tier 0 "From your favorites"** inserted above existing Tier 1 venue-recommended in the CLAUDE.md 2026-05-24 seventh-row 5-tier recommendation ladder (now 6-tier) — surfaces on wizard cards + Plan grid + marketplace search · (d) Compatibility chip overlay (PR #315 pattern) when a favorite's `vendor_profiles.compatible_ceremony_types[]` / `compatible_venue_settings[]` mismatches current event context (e.g., *"This favorite serves Catholic ceremonies — your wedding is civil. Tap to override."*) · (e) New-event creation flow surfaces "Your favorites" strip across every category that has at least one saved vendor — matches Filipino-household reality of vendor relationships compounding across events (caterer they used for Tita's 60th anniversary · photographer who shot the parents' silver anniversary · florist from cousin's debut). **Strategic moat note.** Favorites is real structural defensibility — WedMeGood + The Knot + Zola + Bridestory + Joy don't carry vendor relationships across events. Filipino household reality (parents' anniversaries / wedding / baptism / debut / 60th / wedding-of-cousin all flow through the same family vendor circle) makes per-user persistent favorites disproportionately sticky in PH market. Vendors get a structural reason to deliver well beyond a single event — they get permanent placement in family planning vocabulary. **Schema additions (one consolidated migration).** `ALTER TABLE vendor_services ADD COLUMN price_max_centavos INT NULL CHECK (...)` · `CREATE TABLE user_favorite_vendors (...)` with RLS policies per `02_Specifications/RLS_Policy_Pattern.md` patterns · auto-population trigger extension for `status='considering'` bundle-on-shortlist per § (2). | 2026-05-30 | **🔒 V2.1 BRIEF AMENDMENT #2 REFINEMENT · venue exception locked + engineering kickoff for the screen-name reveal mechanic from line 544 row.** Owner directive verbatim this session: *"Manila Wedding Photographer #4218 return these. this will be for vendors with free and verified accounts. that will be their names. these 'Screen Names' will persist. now when a customer inquires, and the vendor accepts the inquiry and they reply, we can now show the actual name of the vendor. because it is now unlocked. the only vendors that will have no screen names are the Ceremony and Reception Venues. We will let them keep their names."* Three AskUserQuestion answers locked: (a) **Pro + Enterprise = real name from day 1** (paid tier visibility privilege · matches v2.1 § 3 vendor matrix posture · screen names = Free + Verified only) · (b) **Unlock = platform-wide once accepted anywhere** (first vendor-reply on any chat thread permanently stamps `real_name_unlocked_at` · vendor's screen name dies forever everywhere from then on) · (c) **Ship pre-pilot best effort** (4 PRs · ~3 days · 2 days to pilot 2026-06-01). **(1) The venue exception (NEW lock vs line 544 row).** Vendors whose `vendor_profiles.services` array overlaps with `ARRAY['religious_venue', 'venue']` ALWAYS show real `business_name` regardless of `verification_state` · regardless of `real_name_unlocked_at` · regardless of tier. Rationale: ceremony venues + reception venues are physical places with addresses, well-known names, GMB listings, and SEO discoverability that depend on being the actual place — anonymization breaks the venue search experience (couples search "Manila Cathedral" or "Conrad Manila" by name) + makes admin-seeded famous venues from migration `20260529000000_venue_directory_seed.sql` (Cebu Marriott · Shangri-La · Solaire · Conrad · etc.) pointless to surface as taxonomy stubs. Multi-service vendors with venue + catering bundle stay venue (real name) since the venue role is canonical. **(2) Format reconfirmation.** Screen name = `"{City} {Canonical Service Display Label} #{ID}"` per seventh 2026-05-28 row Bark-style and owner's verbatim example *"Manila Wedding Photographer #4218"*. City = `vendor_profiles.location_city`. Canonical Service Display Label = `canonical_service_schemas.display_name_en` lookup on `vendor_profiles.services[0]` (primary canonical service). ID = monotonic increment within `(city, canonical_service)` namespace via new sequence table `vendor_screen_name_sequences`. Slug derived as `kebab-case(screen_name)` → e.g. `manila-wedding-photographer-4218` → used as the public microsite URL at `/v/[slug]` so the URL itself doesn't leak the real `business_slug`. **(3) Persistence rule.** Once screen_name generates on vendor signup, it persists forever — no regeneration if vendor changes services array, location city, or business name. Even after `real_name_unlocked_at` stamps and real name shows everywhere, the underlying screen_name + screen_name_slug stay on the vendor_profiles row (preserves URL continuity for SEO + already-shared inbound links · per CLAUDE.md 2026-05-29 SEO sprint Bucket 4 LocalBusiness JSON-LD pattern). **(4) `displayVendorName(vendor)` helper logic locked.** Returns `vendor.business_name` when ANY of: (a) `vendor.services && ARRAY['religious_venue', 'venue']` (venue exception) · (b) `vendor.tier_state IN ('pro', 'enterprise')` (paid tier unlock) · (c) `vendor.real_name_unlocked_at IS NOT NULL` (post-first-reply unlock). Otherwise returns `vendor.screen_name`. Same logic applies to `displayVendorSlug(vendor)` for microsite URL construction. **(5) Pro + Enterprise tier detection — admin-managed for pilot.** New ENUM `vendor_tier_state AS ENUM ('free', 'verified', 'pro', 'enterprise')` + new column `vendor_profiles.tier_state vendor_tier_state NOT NULL DEFAULT 'free'`. Backfill: any vendor with `verification_state = 'verified'` flips to `tier_state = 'verified'`. Pro + Enterprise stay manually-flippable by admin via `/admin/vendors/[id]` for pilot (5-20 family/friends cohort isn't buying Pro/Enterprise during pilot · won't surface). V1.x post-pilot: auto-derive `tier_state` from active `vendor_subscription_pro_monthly` / `_annual` / `vendor_subscription_enterprise_monthly` / `_annual` order rows · sweep on every Vercel render via lazy-eval per [[reference_setnayan_cron_strategy]] no-cron preference. **(6) Reveal trigger (extends line 544 row's locked mechanic).** DB trigger `BEFORE INSERT` on `chat_messages` where new row's sender is the vendor side of the thread (via `chat_threads.vendor_user_id = NEW.sender_user_id` join) · if `vendor_profiles.real_name_unlocked_at IS NULL` AND vendor is NOT in venue-exception state · stamps `real_name_unlocked_at = NOW()`. Idempotent (only stamps if NULL). Venue-exception vendors skip the trigger fire (already real-name-visible · stamp is meaningless).
